hypothesis: Does extending one fixed J-configuration self-play trajectory from 1024 through 2048 to 4096 games improve development wins across initialization and frozen E/F anchors?
basis: J2048 failed all win gates; stopped G was incomplete and used another discount. Additional training is untested, not presumed beneficial.
change: Training count only. Full-state snapshots and evaluation progress instrumentation; separate per-player evaluation RNG streams applied identically to all count checkpoints.

development.selection: highest minimum opponent win fraction, then aggregate wins, then fewer total timeouts, then earliest checkpoint
development.gate: strictly >60% wins and <=20% timeouts against EACH opponent
development.rationale: Three count points bracket historical 2048 budget and one doubling, costing 576 development games. Initialization checks learning from scratch; E/F check opponent specificity. Identical per-opponent seeds and seats across counts support paired outcome comparisons.

confirmation.only_after: complete training/development and frozen selected hash passing development gate
confirmation.gate: 95% Wilson lower win fraction >0.5 and <=20% timeouts against EACH opponent
confirmation.rationale: Only a frozen development winner passing every gate receives 200 fresh games per anchor; preserves held-out test and controls.
confirmation.budget_rule: Run only if all 600 games plus recovery fit remaining deadline; otherwise incomplete confirmation, no promotion or second allocation.

replication.status: Required before promotion, not executed in this single-trajectory iteration.

scope: Fixed arena, two agents. Seeds vary policy sampling, not layouts. E/F are frozen anchors, not matched-duration candidates. Historical J results use a different evaluation RNG scheme and are not pooled. No cross-family ranking evidence or arena replacement is implied.

evaluation_settings.rng: Separate challenger/reference generators, seed_base+1000000000/+2000000000, same streams across count checkpoints

checkpoint_strategy: Restart from scratch; no previous K training exists
continuation_authority: Owner-reviewed failed allocation, fresh attempt6, no changes to scientific settings
confirmation_timing: Only if >=600s remain after development; otherwise preserve selection and defer without promotion
